name: VDB-GPDF
aliases: Online Gaussian Process Distance Field with VDB Structure
Volumetric Dynamic grid that shares several characteristics with B+trees Gaussian Process Distance Field
definition: An online efficient mapping framework that couples Gaussian Process (GP) distance fields with the OpenVDB data structure to enable fast queries of Euclidean distance, surface properties, and uncertainties for arbitrary points, while maintaining a global structure over time via probabilistic fusion.
summary: VDB-GPDF is an online mapping framework coupling Gaussian Process distance fields with OpenVDB to enable fast, probabilistic Euclidean distance queries with uncertainty, bypassing the post-processing required by TSDF methods.
